awards.title: Rookie All-Star & Rookie Inspiration
awards.details: Recognized as the rookie team that best represents a model for other teams, showing determination and Gracious Professionalism in its first competitive season.

awards.title: District Event Finalist
awards.details: Advanced to the finals as part of the alliance captain lineup at multiple district events, back to back seasons.

awards.title: Creativity Award
awards.details: Won during the team's historic rookie season on the global stage, recognizing an innovative approach to the game.

awards.title: Autonomous Award
awards.event: 2025 FIM Michigan State Championship (Consumers Energy Division)
awards.details: Celebrates a team with consistent, high-performing robot automation on the state championship stage.

awards.title: Creativity Award
awards.details: Recognizes a robot mechanism designed with resourceful, out-of-the-box thinking for this season's game.

awards.title: Team Sustainability Award
awards.details: Recognizes a team's creative and resourceful sustainable business, fundraising, and outreach practices across two district events.

awards.title: Judges' Award
awards.details: A judges' discretion award given to a team that made a significant impact worthy of recognition outside the standard award categories.
